note: codex.py not called (Codex out of credits). The coordinator ran the three readers on draft 1 as fresh-context agents: claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context).

claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context). No major; four minors on three verses. Tenses (the futures of 9, 10, 17, 18, 19, 21), moods, images and pointing approved. One taken (50:20), three refused and kept as options.

outcomes.remark: *ficarei mais branco* loses the passive of *dealbábor*; fix *serei branqueado mais do que a neve*
outcomes.reason: *ficar* + adjective is the Portuguese resultative; *branqueado* is laundry and bleach

outcomes.remark: *justítiam tuam* is an object: *exultará a vossa justiça*
outcomes.reason: *exultar* is never transitive in Portuguese nor in the fourteen finished uses; *na* is 12:6b, 34:9

outcomes.remark: *benígne fac* is an act: *Tratai benignamente … a Sião*

note: claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context). Six remarks on six verses; best line 50:7, worst 50:8. Five taken (8, 9, 18, 20, 21), one refused (3b, a glossary row).

outcomes.reason: the miseratiónes row (24:6, passed twice); *clemências* is already an option

outcomes.remark: *amastes … manifestastes* rhyme at mediant and final; long colon with the verb last
outcomes.reason: *vós me manifestastes …* leads; the stylist's added *e* not taken (the Latin's asyndeton)

outcomes.remark: *do que a neve* slack → *que a neve*
*eu certamente o teria dado* stumbles → *eu o teria dado certamente*
*com Sião* dangles → Sião before *na vossa boa vontade*
*porão* heard as the noun → *sobre o vosso altar porão bezerros*

note: claude-opus-5-5 (fresh context). 27 readings; the likely hearing was the intended one almost everywhere. Unclear hearings that are the Latin's own and kept: the purpose clause of 50:6 (Rom 3:4), the mother in 50:7, whose *espírito soberano* (14), *do sangue* as bloodshed (16, D29), who judges God (6), *Sacrifício a Deus* (19). Real risks: *porão* the noun (21, fixed by the stylist's order), *atribulado* = hectic (19, kept with note), *incertas* = doubtful (8, kept: *ocultas* steers). Unknown: hissopo, aspergireis (the Asperges words), holocaustos (row), entranhas (row, the organ kept), soberano — kept.

outcomes.reason: beside *espírito* and *contrito* it is heard as afflicted; alternatives carry worse (quebranto) or another verb's word
the Latin word; *obscuras* stays an option
the Greek's sense; God's own sovereign spirit is a reading the Latin allows
